answer: Mentor co-guarantee: a newcomer gets voting weight only if an established mentor locks 30 POA on it for 60 days, and each mentor backs at most 3 newcomers. Cost of 1 fake: 30 POA; 10 fakes: 4 mentors and 300 POA; 100 fakes: 34 mentors and 3000 POA, while an honest user is backed once. Every pairing sits in a public orchard registry, and auditors check 5% of pairs at random; a mentor whose newcomer is a copy loses all 30 POA. Fakes that wander between wallets get traced to one funder. Mentors who whisper to each other can still collude.
